pages.text: A finished brew matches on the exact set of herbs you add, and draws altar power to complete. These are the recipes the cauldron knows.
Sleeping Draught — Mandrake Root + Belladonna Flower. Costs 50 power, and grants Slowness II and Blindness.
Brew of Frailty — Wolfsbane + Wormwood. Costs 30 power, and grants Weakness II and Mining Fatigue.
Witch's Sight — Icy Needle + Water Artichoke. Costs 40 power, and grants Night Vision and Water Breathing.
Bloodwort Tonic — Mandrake Root + Wolfsbane. Costs 60 power, and grants Strength and Resistance.
Hag's Swiftness — Water Artichoke + Wormwood. Costs 40 power, and grants Speed II and Jump Boost.
Withering Bile — Belladonna Flower + Icy Needle. Costs 30 power, and grants Poison II and Wither.
